# Integration marks

- `oclif.svg`, `docusaurus.svg`, and `vitepress.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/), fetched from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@latest/icons/{oclif,docusaurus,vitepress}.svg` on 2026-09-19. Simple Icons distributes brand icons under [CC0 1.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).
- `yargs-logo.png`: official [yargs logo](https://github.com/yargs/yargs/blob/main/yargs-logo.png), fetched from the yargs repository on 2026-09-19.
- `commander.svg`: local text wordmark created for this site from the project name. This is not an official project logo asset.
